title: Vitality Circuit
description: Dynamic 3-round circuit alternating lunges, Hindu push-ups, plank and mountain climbers

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm to the sky

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step back, lower the knee

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Dive movement: pike down then sweep up in an arc

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs in the air, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, drive hips up, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
